messages:
natalie: Assessor asked for a focused retest next week specifically for RBAC and KMS flows. We need: owners, a retest checklist, audit logs export, and a presigned evidence upload flow. Can we confirm? :mag:
kevin: I can do KMS bits and presigned uploads. Will craft a scoped key grant and a temporary key policy for the assessor session. Planning to use an IAM session with an inline policy that only allows `kms:Decrypt` for specific key alias.
sam: I'll scope the RM role. `pt-assessor-limited` with permissions: s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject (evidence bucket path only), cloudwatch:GetLogEvents, logs:GetLogRecord. Timebox to 4h. No wildcard resources.
liz: Reminder: do not add broad `iam:PassRole` — we need no additional privilege surface during retest.
maria: I'm taking vuln-418 (improper KMS context fallback) and will open a PR this morning. ETA 3h. Will include unit/regression tests for key context handling.
jon: Ops: which retest windows are available? I'm blocked until we lock one.
natalie: Preferred: Mon 10:00-14:00 PT or Wed 08:00-12:00 PT. Which can we staff?
matt: Wed 08-12 PT works for oncall. Confirmed.
natalie: Great. @assessor-bot please tentatively reserve Wed 08-12 PT.
assessor-bot: Requested slot reserved: Wed 08:00-12:00 PT. Please provide evidence upload manifest and access details 24h prior.
kevin: Plan for evidence upload: presigned PUTs to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/assessor_183210/, manifest.json with sha256 checksums. Example curl: ```curl -X PUT "<presigned_url>" -T artifact.tar.gz -H "x-amz-meta-checksum:sha256:<sha256>"```
sam: RBAC snapshot step: run `rbacctl snapshot --out roles_183210.txt --include-delegation` and include a brief doc mapping services -> principal paths. Keep snapshot in evidence but redact any internal sensitive IDs.
liz: Audit log export: we need CloudTrail events covering key usage + AssumeRole events for the 90d window around last changes. If CloudTrail retention <90d, export to S3 and include in bundle. Ops, confirm retention.
matt: Prod CloudTrail: 365d. Staging: 45d. We'll run an export for staging for 90d and include the gzipped CSVs.
kevin: KMS note: assessor must not have direct key policies. I'll use a grant for `Decrypt` with constraints on encryption context and a fixed grant token. Also will rotate the grant ID after use.
maria: PR opened: fix/418-kms-context-fallback -> includes test and verification steps. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/789. Added runbook snippet to reproduce.
jon: Good. For retest, what's the rollback plan if the assessor finds a regression? We need a quick revert and emergency contact list.
natalie: Rollback: revert PR, redeploy via canary to 0, and reapply previous stable config. Oncall will own rollback. Add emergency contact list to evidence bundle (names + pager).
matt: Oncall will be on rotation Wed morning. I'll add pager details to the manifest metadata.
kevin: Packaging: evidence directory layout:
  - manifest.json
  - roles_snapshot.txt
  - cloudtrail_exports/
  - logs/
  - prs.md (links to remediation PRs)
I'll upload a ZIP to S3 and provide presigned GETs for assessor to download after upload verification.
sam: Security review: ensure manifest.json contains field `redactions` listing any redacted objects and justification. Also include hash digests for all artifacts.
liz: Small ops ask: make sure S3 ACLs are set to private and disable `ListBucket` for the assessor role. We'll give exact prefixes only.
kevin: Will restrict presigned URLs to `assessor_183210/*` prefix and include an `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header in presigned PUTs. Example presign generation command I'll post in thread.
natalie: Final checklist: owners assigned (kevin KMS/evidence, sam RBAC + role creation, maria vuln fix #418, matt oncall/exports), retest Wed 08-12 PT, manifest + presigned links 24h prior, include rollback contact + runbooks. Anyone object?
maria: No objections. I'll also attach test output in PR for reviewer confidence.
jon: Approved. Can someone add a short note in the PRs referencing this thread_ts (1832100000) so we can tie everything back?
kevin: Done. I'll post presigned links and the grant ARN by EOD today.
natalie: Thanks team. Small follow-up: make sure assessor session logs have a unique session tag so we can filter CloudTrail easily (e.g., `AssessorSession=183210`).
kevin: Added `x-redwood-session:assessor-183210` to session policy. We'll be able to filter.
natalie: Closing loop: we'll reconvene 24h before retest to confirm final artifacts. :white_check_mark:
